+title: 'Background engine: always return the handle, no race'
+---
+## What
+Rework the engine in `Sources/FoundationModelsRouter/Hosting/DetachingTool.swift` so a background tool call never returns an in-band result:
+
+- [ ] In `Mode.background`, `call(arguments:)` starts the wrapped tool's body, tracks the run in the session's `SessionMailbox` at once (`track(tool:op:kind:completionToken:settling:canceler:)`), and returns the `PendingRunEnvelope` immediately. There is no wait window and no fast path.
+- [ ] Delete the soft-deadline race: the window sleep, the window-elapse claim, and the claim arbitration between "in-band result" and "detach" (`RaceGate` use for the window). Keep the arbitration between natural settlement and `timeout` expiry — that race is real.
+- [ ] Keep the timeout watcher unchanged: progress resets it, a pending elicitation suspends it, expiry cancels the work and settles the run as `OperationOutcome.timedOut` with one terminal event.
+- [ ] Rewrite the `PendingRunEnvelope` `next` text: the tool now always answers with a handle; the text tells the model that the run continues, that the session will report the result when the run settles, and that `wait` with the `completionToken` collects it.
+- [ ] In `Mode.runToCompletion`, behavior is unchanged: block to completion; a `timeout` expiry throws `DetachingToolError.timedOut(tool:timeoutSeconds:)` to the model as a named tool failure.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] A background tool call returns a `PendingRunEnvelope` on every call, also when the body completes in microseconds. A test proves it.
+- [ ] `rg 'waitSeconds' Sources` returns no match.
+- [ ] The exactly-one-terminal-event invariant holds across natural settle, cancel, timeout, and `close()` sweep. The existing tests for it stay green.
+- [ ] `swift build` and the full suite are green.
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] Rewrite the race cases in `Tests/FoundationModelsRouterTests/DetachingToolTests.swift` as immediate-handle cases.
+- [ ] Simplify fixtures that used `waitSeconds: 0` (`detachAtOnceMount` in `DeclaredRunKindTests.swift`, `RegisteredJournalOpTests.swift`) — background mode now does this always.
+- [ ] Run `swift test` — green.
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` — write failing tests first, then implement to make them pass. #long-running #api
\ No newline at end of file
